senses.definition: n.f. end (so BH (late); 𝔗 (Gn 47:2); not Syriac; cf. Egyptian Aramaic RÉS361 A4);—cstr. לְק׳ at the end of (months, days) Dn 4:26, 31; מִן־ק׳מַלְכוּתָא 2:43 = part of (‖ מִנַּהּ v d; cf. BH קְצָת 2).
